---
title: "TAF repositories"
---

Every analysis in TAF is a repository in the [ices-taf](https://github.com/ices-taf) organisation on GitHub. This page summarises the repositories named for a year, `<year>_<name>`, and those of the workshops, `wk_WK<name>`. The other repositories in the organisation, such as the software, are left out. The templates are in ices-tools-dev and ices-tools-prod, see [TAF templates](templates.qmd). [Stock assessments](stock-assessments.qmd) looks at the assessments linked to advice.

{{< include ../_taf/site/report/status-summary.md >}}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_plot.R")

repos <- read.csv("../_taf/site/data/repos.csv")

# the type of the repositories named for a year: the most common types and
# some others of interest, largest first, and the rest together
n_types <- 8
of_interest <- c("data", "forecast", "acousticIndex")
common <- names(sort(table(repos$type), decreasing = TRUE))
shown <- common[common %in% c(head(common, n_types), of_interest)]
repos$group <- ifelse(is.na(repos$type) | repos$type %in% shown, repos$type, "other")
type_groups <- c(shown, if (length(common) > length(shown)) "other")
```

## Repositories by year

Repositories named for a year, `<year>_<name>`, counted by that year.

```{r}
#| echo: false
by_year <- as.data.frame(table(year = repos$year))
by_year$year <- as.numeric(as.character(by_year$year))

plot_ly(
  by_year,
  x = ~year, y = ~Freq,
  type = "bar", marker = list(color = blue),
  hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y} repositories<extra></extra>"
) |>
  taf_layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "", dtick = 1),
    yaxis = list(title = "Repositories")
  )
```

## Repositories by type

The type is the last part of the repository name, `<year>_<name>_<type>`, for the repositories named for a year. Stock repositories without a type are counted as assessments, as are those for a part of a stock, `<year>_<stock>_<west or south>`.

Click a bar to list the repositories of that type in the table below. To show them all again, use the button above the table or double-click the chart.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
# the repositories, shared by the chart and the table so that clicking a bar
# filters the table
lock <- "<i class=\"bi bi-lock-fill\" title=\"Private\"></i><span class=\"visually-hidden\">private</span>"
listed <- data.frame(
  Repository = sprintf("<a href=\"%s\">%s</a>", repos$url, htmltools::htmlEscape(repos$name)),
  Year = repos$year,
  Type = ifelse(is.na(repos$type), "", repos$type),
  Private = ifelse(repos$visibility == "public", "", lock),
  "Last updated" = substr(repos$pushed, 1, 10),
  check.names = FALSE
)
shared <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(listed)

# a bar for each type, carrying the keys of its repositories, which is what
# links it to the rows of the table. The largest is at the top.
bars <- data.frame(type = factor(rev(type_groups), rev(type_groups)))
bars$key <- I(lapply(as.character(bars$type), function(type) shared$key()[repos$group %in% type]))
bars$n <- lengths(bars$key)

plot_ly(
  linked_bars(bars, shared),
  x = ~n, y = ~type,
  type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = blue),
  hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x} repositories<extra></extra>"
) |>
  taf_layout(
    barmode = "overlay",
    xaxis = list(title = "Repositories"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", ticksuffix = "  ")
  ) |>
  highlight(
    on = "plotly_click", off = "plotly_doubleclick", opacityDim = 0.35,
    selected = attrs_selected(showlegend = FALSE)
  ) |>
  config(doubleClickDelay = 500)
```

## Repositories

The repositories, most recently updated first. Those marked with a lock are private, so their links only work for members of the organisation.

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_all_button(shared, "Show all repositories")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
DT::datatable(
  shared,
  rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 25, order = list(list(4, "desc")))
)
```
